nameEn: Processing and preserving of fruit and vegetables
description: This class includes the processing and preserving of fruit and vegetables, including frozen, canned, pickled, dried or dehydrated forms. It includes production of fruit and vegetable juices, fruit pastes and jellies, and other preserved fruit and vegetable products.
includes: production of frozen fruit and vegetables
production of canned or bottled fruit and vegetables
production of fruit and vegetable juices
production of fruit pastes and jellies
drying and dehydration of fruit and vegetables
excludes: growing of fruit and vegetables, see 011, 012
manufacture of fruit and vegetable oils, see 1040
manufacture of prepared meals and dishes, see 1075
